entities.name: PMID:27504739
observations: ADDITION-DK analysis of 1,481 people with screen-detected type 2 diabetes assessed serum methylglyoxal and renal measures over six years.

entities.name: Methylglyoxal
observations: Serum glycolysis-derived metabolite measured at baseline and six-year follow-up in ADDITION-DK.

entities.name: Methylglyoxal–kidney association
observations: In 1,481 participants with screen-detected T2D, baseline methylglyoxal was associated with 12% higher baseline ACR per doubling; six-year methylglyoxal change was inversely associated with eGFR change (-1.6 mL/min/1.73 m² per doubling), adjusted for clinical covariates.
